text:
alex: Heads-up — planning a kernel + quant bump tonight at 23:00 UTC. Target: kernel v2.7.1 + quant profile q4.0. Canary for 30m, then stagger slices if all green. Need a canary owner, SRE standby, and QA smoke list. Who can take the canary?

priya: I can own the canary (23:00-00:00 UTC). I'll run the perf smoke and basic correctness prompts.

jamie: I'll be on SRE watch. Will wire up latency/error alerts and pager rules for the window. Please post the rollout command so I can confirm the alert thresholds match.

alex: Rollout CLI I'm planning to use:
```
redwoodctl rollout start --image kernel-v2.7.1 --quant-profile q4.0 \\n  --slices canary:1 --canary-duration 30m --stagger 10m --timeout 1h
```
Note: canary uses slice 1, then slices 2-10 in 10m staggers.

rohan: I'll pre-push the kernel image to eu-west1 and us-central1 registries now. Also recommend adding a KV prewarm step, otherwise first requests will see cold misses. Suggest: add `--kv-warmup 3m` to the command.

sasha: QA checklist I'll run during canary (short, prioritized):
1) sanity prompt: `summarize: 2 paragraphs` and diff embeddings with baseline (cosine > 0.98).
2) tail-latency tail(99.9) < 1.2x baseline.
3) KV cache hit-rate > 85% after warmup.
4) regression smoke against saved prompt set (10 prompts) — no top-1 answer drift > 5%.
I'll paste results inline as I run them.

jamie: Alerts I'm adding now:
- latency_p99 > 1.5x baseline for 5m -> paged to oncall
- error_rate > 0.5% for 5m -> paged
- model_fallback_rate > 1% -> silent alert to #eng-runtime
Also adding a dashboard panel with canary vs baseline token cost and KV hit-rate.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout created by alex: id=rl-2987654321, window=23:00 UTC, canary_slice=1, stagger=10m.

alex: Rollback command if we need it quickly:
```
redwoodctl rollout rollback --id rl-2987654321 --to-image kernel-v2.7.0 --slices all --force
```
Plan: if any single alert fires during canary, we abort canary and rollback immediately. If issues appear during stagger, we'll pause and escalate.

priya: Ack — I'll run probes at start, + 10m, +25m. Will post perf numbers and sample responses.

rohan: Pushed images to registries and pre-warm script queued. Adding `--kv-warmup 3m` to the rollout.

sasha: I'll start the regression suite at T+5m and post diffs in this thread.

jamie: Oncall is aware. I'll escalate to infra if rollback needed. Also creating a short incident channel #rl-2987654321 if we abort.

alex: Perfect. Quick thumbs up when you see this so I can flip the scheduled job to "go".

priya: :thumbsup:
